The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 26 cm, so the ribs are roughly 20 cm long.

There are two rib sections, each about 3-4 cm wide, which looks like 4-5 bones each. They are glazed with BBQ sauce. Each section probably weighs about 100-120 g with the bone, so the two together are about 220 g. Meat without bone is perhaps 120 g. Pork ribs run about 250-300 kcal per 100 g of edible meat, and with sauce I estimate about 350 kcal for the ribs.

The 4 baby carrots weigh about 40 g and add about 15 kcal.

Total mass is about 260 g and total energy is about 370 kcal.
